context: Sachiko and Goro reflect on their long life together.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: おじいちゃん、長かった、人生、ね。
lines.en: Grandpa — life was long, wasn't it.
lines.style: Soft, wondering opening. Voice full of quiet affection. Slow, deliberate pace — not hurried. The kind of reflection that stops time for a moment. Warmth underneath every word, genuine and unperformed.

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.en: Yes — truly, it went by fast.
lines.style: Measured agreement, almost to himself. Deep calm in the voice. A pause before speaking, as if gathering something true. Patient, weathered kindness. The certainty of someone who has lived it.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.en: So many memories — we have them.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost marveling. Gentle uplift on 'memories' — genuine wonder at the weight of a life lived. Soft smile audible. Reflective pace. Fingers through time, not rushing past any of it.

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.en: I'm grateful — to have spent it with you.
lines.style: Quiet, steady voice. The words land like stones in still water. Not performative gratitude — this is bone-deep. Slight exhale before speaking, as if emotion needed room. Tender firmness underneath.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.en: The feeling is mine too — truly.
lines.style: Echoing his warmth back to him. Gentle, assured. No need to add more — just meeting him in the same space. Voice soft as his. The matched rhythm of two people who have loved each other for decades.

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.style: Promise and presence woven together. Quiet but unshakable. The kind of certainty that comes from having walked the whole road. No tremor, no doubt. Just steady hands and steady voice.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.en: You are so precious to me.
lines.style: Whispered almost, but not fragile. Final words carrying everything unsaid across a lifetime. Breath catches slightly — love too big for one sentence. Held, not rushed. The closing of something sacred.
